1: -module(hty_figlet_SUITE).
    2: 
    3: -export([all/0, groups/0, init_per_group/2, end_per_group/2, init_per_testcase/2, end_per_testcase/2]).
    4: -export([single_level/1]).
    5: 
    6: all() -> [
    7:     {group, foldered}
    8: ].
    9: 
   10: groups() ->
   11:     [{foldered, [
   12:         single_level
   13:     ]}].
   14: 
   15: init_per_group(Group, Config) ->
   16:     Groupname = atom_to_list(Group),
   17:     Groupdir = proplists:get_value(data_dir, Config) ++ Groupname,
   18:     [{group_dir, Groupdir}|Config].
   19: 
   20: end_per_group(_Group, Config) -> Config.
   21:     
   22: init_per_testcase(Test, Config) -> 
   23:     Fixture = proplists:get_value(group_dir, Config) ++ "/" ++ atom_to_list(Test),
   24:     [{fixture, Fixture}|Config].
   25: 
   26: end_per_testcase(_Test, _Config) -> ok.
   27: 
   28: -record(testcase, {prefix, facit}).
   29: 
   30: run_test(Cfg, Testcase) ->
   31:     Rootdir = proplists:get_value(fixture, Cfg),
   32:     Self = self(),
   33:     
   34:     Figtree = {
   35:         "root.hty_figlet_test",
   36:         hty_figlet:lister_file(Rootdir)
   37:     },
   38:     
   39:     Resolver = hty_figlet:new_resolver_modfromext(),
   40:     
   41:     Collector = fun(Figlet) ->  
   42:         Figlet = Testcase#testcase.facit,
   43:         Self ! {ok, Figlet}
   44:     end,
   45:     
   46:     {ok, Pid} = hty_figlet:watch(Figtree, Resolver, Collector),
   47:     receive 
   48:         {ok, result} -> 
   49:             ok
   50:         after 
   51:             1000 -> 
   52:             Pid ! stop,
   53:             fail
   54:     end.
   55: 
   56: single_level(Cfg) -> 
   57:     run_test(Cfg, #testcase{
   58:         prefix=[],
   59:         facit={hty_figlet_test, "ett", "tu", "tre"}
   60:     }).
   61:
